Loopfour turns the processes your team runs every month into governed, auditable automation. Build your first workflow Deterministic code, not black-box AI SOC 2 Type II · SOC 1 Type I Every run logged, with approvals Book a workflow review See the controls The finance AI problem The real AI risk in finance isn’t slowness. It’s exposure. Your board wants AI in finance, and your auditors want it to hold up. But finance does not run on “probably.” An LLM that invents a number, silently cuts a corner, or cannot show its work is not an efficiency gain. It is a liability you have to sign your name to at close. There is a fourth option: automation you can defend, with a full evidence trail under every action. Rigid finance AI tools Template-first products may satisfy a checklist, but they force your process into somebody else’s template. DIY agents and scripts Something a sharp operator vibe-codes can work, until it drifts, breaks, or leaves with the person who built it. Then nobody can show how a number was produced. Doing nothing Your control environment stays exactly as thin as it is today, while your team keeps burning days on report pulls, reconciliations, and copy-paste between systems. What Loopfour is Deterministic workflow automation for finance. Loopfour automates AR, close, and revenue recognition as deterministic, auditable code, not black-box AI, on top of the tools you already use. Real code, not runtime guesses Every workflow runs a fixed, versioned set of steps. Any change to a live workflow creates a new version, and every version is retained. Scoped AI where it belongs AI can read a contract or classify a document, but confidence thresholds and human fallback keep it from deciding what your finance system does. Full execution evidence Every action, approval, exception, and system write is logged so finance leaders and auditors can inspect the run instead of trusting a black box. What you can automate The finance workflows teams hand us first. Each one runs as deterministic code on the systems you already use, with approvals where you want them and an audit trail underneath all of it. See AP workflows Revenue Recognition & Contract-to-Cash ASC 606 schedules derived from the contract, deferred revenue tracked as it releases, and the same journal entries booked the same way every period. Revenue recognition automation Payment Reconciliation & Cash Application Deterministic matching across your bank, ERP, and payment rails. Exceptions route to a person with the context attached instead of landing in a spreadsheet. Account reconciliation automation Month-End Close Reconciliations, journal entries, and close checklists that run on schedule, with the audit evidence captured as the work happens rather than reassembled afterward. Month-end close automation Why deterministic matters Auditors test controls, not tools. Loopfour gives them a versioned workflow, an approval record and a log of every run. We use AI where it belongs, such as interpreting a document, but never to decide what your finance system does.
